article.title: 中銀香港冠名港珠澳大橋賽事，新設十公里挑戰組
article.summary: 香港電台報道，港珠澳大橋香港段半馬舉行，本屆增設十公里挑戰組。中國銀行（香港）是賽事冠名贊助商。
highlights: 賽事獲世界田徑聯會認可為白金級道路賽。
香港公益金另獲分配慈善名額。
article.why: 體育贊助團隊可為不同跑程及公益參與設獨立報名和成效指標。
article.next_step: 按跑程及慈善名額整理報名來源、到場率與捐款紀錄，分開評估各項安排。
article.detail: 香港電台確認港珠澳大橋香港段半馬已舉行，本屆設半馬及新增十公里挑戰組。中銀香港為賽事冠名贊助商，香港公益金表示獲分配慈善名額。體育贊助團隊可分開檢視不同賽程與公益參與，並以有效報名、實際出席和捐款等指標核對活動設計。不同類別的指標應以相同觀察期比較。
article.title_en: BOCHK title-sponsored bridge race adds a 10km challenge
article.summary_en: RTHK reported that the Hong Kong section bridge half marathon took place with a new 10km Challenge. Bank of China (Hong Kong) is the title sponsor.
highlights_en: World Athletics recognizes the event as a Platinum Label Road Race.
The Community Chest received a separate allocation of charity places.
article.why_en: Sports sponsors can use separate registration and measurement for distances and charity participation.
article.next_step_en: Break out registration sources, attendance and donations by distance or charity entry.
article.detail_en: RTHK confirmed that the bridge half marathon took place with a new 10km Challenge. BOCHK is the title sponsor, and the Community Chest said it received charity places. Sports sponsors can review participation by race category or charity route and measure valid registrations, attendance and donations separately. Use a consistent observation window when comparing categories.
